newsitem.title: INDIA: India L&T subsidiary to raise FD rate.
newsitem.headline: India L&T subsidiary to raise FD rate.

text.p: L&T Finance Ltd (LTF), a wholly-owend subsidiary of India's Larsen & Toubro Ltd said it received Reserve Bank of India (RBI) certification allowing it to fix interest rates on fixed deposits.
"The certificate has been issued to LTF because of its compliance with various RBI requirements with respect to credit rating and prudential norms," it said in a statement.

"LTF is planning to pass on the benefit of the permission received from RBI to its investors and mobilise deposits at a higher rate of interest under the new deposit schemes to be announced shortly," it said.
It said the Credit Rating Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) upgraded rating on LTF deposits to FAA- from FA+.
"The enhancement of the rating is significant in the light of a spate of downgrading of ratings by CRISIL of some of the well-known companies," the statement said.
